card.name: Multiplication signs in dose formulas
card.fires_on: The multiplication sign, the word multiply, or an equals sign right after a quantity such as weight (kg) in a dose or clearance formula.

modes.label: Multiply after weight
modes.description: A times sign or 'by' follows weight in kg in a dose or creatinine clearance calculation.

modes.label: Equals or multiply in other calculations
modes.description: The word multiply or an equals sign appears in a worked formula or counting instruction.
